title: Pirate Captain
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: Pirate Captain Finhead Stonebone is prisoner of a ruthless Hutt ganglord, Great Bogga, in this Dave Dorman cover illustration for Dark Horse Comics' TALES OF THE JEDI, this one "The Saga of Nomi Sunrider." Nomi's Jedi husband is murdered on orders of the Hutt, but she takes up his lightsaber, the first step to becoming a true Jedi Knight herself.
